event.summary: Retried archive moves still enter the discard journal
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 47f33bbdbd5ff4a6e437e97a800f9083be43096e. TLDR: considered whether retrying an environment session Delete after an interrupted archive could leave its checkout as an ordinary archive rather than remove it. Source refutation: archive_last_reference at teardown.rs:1401-1436 treats both ReconcileOutcome::Moved and MetadataComplete as moved=true; only SourceMissing produces false. The Discard branch at 1066-1074 therefore puts recovered moved checkouts into discard just like a fresh move, and 1125-1128 passes those IDs into the deleting transaction. Contract: SPEC_impl.md, Environment Delete and the seal, 6607-6618 requires non-final environment Delete to discard the last checkout reference. Suggested bucket: other (hypothesized incomplete cleanup); confidence: confirmed source refutation; proposed_drop: true, refuted by the source above; possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work consequence; this hypothesis concerned retained files. No execution or reproduction performed.

event.summary: Retried archive moves and committed discards retain removal recovery
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 47f33bbdbd5ff4a6e437e97a800f9083be43096e. TLDR: considered whether retrying a non-final environment session Delete after an interrupted archive, or restarting after its deleting transaction, could leave the checkout as an ordinary archive instead of removing it. Initial source refutation remains: teardown.rs:1401-1436 treats ReconcileOutcome::Moved and MetadataComplete as moved=true, so Discard collects those IDs at 1066-1074 and passes them into the deleting transaction at 1125-1128. Synthesis checks/results: store.rs:3838-3877 removes this membership, checks zero remaining members, retires ArchivePending, and calls journal_removal in the same transaction; checkout_trash.rs:56-71 writes the .rm: destination using repoint_retired. Both post-commit finish at teardown.rs:1152-1187 and startup use resume_retirement: checkout_trash.rs:899-963 scans retired .rm: rows, checks zero members and retained session paths, accepts the already-hidden directory or finishes the original-to-hidden rename, and queues only verified content. A definite missing original and hidden directory forgets the record; failures retain the journal. service/trash_remover.rs:356-373 obtains authoritative retained session paths and keeps supervisor ownership through the blocking recovery. core.rs:8734-8749 awaits this recovery, enqueues it and starts the remover before the accept loop. Readily checkable recovery premises are settled by source, with no missing premise for this hypothesis. Contract: SPEC_impl.md Environment Delete and the seal at 6607-6618 requires non-final environment Delete to discard the last checkout reference; SPEC.md Managed checkouts requires accepted cleanup to resume after restart and protect retained session paths. Suggested bucket: other (original hypothetical incomplete cleanup); confidence: confirmed source refutation; proposed_drop: true for that hypothesis, no parent drop accepted; possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work consequence in the retained-files hypothesis. Caveat: this establishes the recovery wiring and ownership checks, not an execution observation or a promise that filesystem failures cannot retain cleanup for retry. No execution or reproduction performed.
